- bul_ibm_001: Architected cloud-native AI and analytics platforms that enabled governed enterprise decision systems operating at 99.9% uptime across regulated financial environments.
- bul_ibm_002: Led migration from legacy on-prem environments to scalable cloud-native architectures, reducing infrastructure overhead by 30% and creating the data and compute foundation for faster analytics and ML deployment.
- bul_ibm_003: Converted bespoke regulatory and analytics workflows into reusable SaaS-like platforms, improving renewal rates by 25% through standardized architecture, shared services, and repeatable lifecycle management.
- bul_ibm_004: Engineered near-real-time ingestion, lineage, and observability frameworks that reduced regulatory response latency by 50% while improving trace integrity and operational transparency across distributed data flows.
- bul_ibm_005: Structured multi-year hyperscaler alliances generating $15M in incremental revenue through co-sell motions aligned to platform modernization and AI growth.

At IBM, led enterprise-scale cloud, data, lineage and observability foundations for regulated financial services, establishing the reliability and governance discipline that supported later production AI platform leadership.

Engineering executive with expertise in designing and operationalizing governed agentic AI platforms for regulated enterprise environments. Built and applied software dependency graph intelligence to enhance architecture visibility and reduce refactor risk, while leading the scaling of the ML engineering organization from 8 to 28 specialists. Achieved a 40% reduction in regulatory reporting errors through the implementation of Basel III/CCAR data lineage and validation frameworks.
